mapper.insert: insert into payment_transaction (payment_no, order_id, user_id, channel, idempotency_key, amount_cent, status, gateway_trade_no, callback_event_id, expires_at, succeeded_at, failure_code, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{paymentNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{channel}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{amountCent}, #{status}, #{gatewayTradeNo}, #{callbackEventId}, #{expiresAt}, #{succeededAt}, #{failureCode}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from payment_transaction where payment_no = #{paymentNo} limit 1
select * from payment_transaction where payment_no = #{paymentNo} limit 1 for update
select * from payment_transaction where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1
select * from payment_transaction where order_id = #{orderId} and status = #{status} order by id desc limit 1
select * from payment_transaction where status = 'PROCESSING' and gateway_trade_no is not null order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update payment_transaction set status = #{status}, gateway_trade_no = coalesce(#{gatewayTradeNo}, gateway_trade_no), callback_event_id = coalesce(#{callbackEventId}, callback_event_id), failure_code = #{failureCode}, succeeded_at = #{succeededAt}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus}
